services.desc: 'Liquid Light' is a solo exhibit of interactive installations and light sculptures by DMA alumnus Justin Lui. Justin Lui is an artist and designer pursuing the integration of responsive media into the physical world. He explores the intersections between media technology and architecture in order to create objects, spaces, and surfaces which are dynamic and intelligent. This pursuit is catalyzed by a desire create a sense of bodily engagement between participant and installation space. His projects often explore the material effects that can arise when digital media and illumination are combined with physical material.
